 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). From the repository root:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest
+```
+
+To run a single file or a single test:
+
+```sh
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+python3 -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+If pytest is not already available, install it first with `python3 -m pip install pytest`.
